title: NASA is Reinventing Aviation
description: Today NASA is reinventing aviation for the next 50 years, where aircraft look different, are powered different, and perform many more missions to improve our daily lives. We’re helping the United States create the first-ever commercial supersonic flight market over land, find the answers to successful electric propulsion in large aircraft, and lead the development of advanced air mobility options.
